steps.text: Open **Shop › Advanced** (tab **Payment Rules**).
steps.label: Payment Rules

steps.text: Click the **Discount Codes** card to open ‘Create a Rule’ dialog.
steps.label: Discount Codes

steps.text: Toggle **Rule is enabled** ON. Enter **Rule Name** (internal, admins only) and **User-Facing Name** (shown in cart — auto-copies from Rule Name; change it if needed).
steps.label: Rule is enabled

steps.text: In the **IF** section: field shows ‘Discount Code equals’. Clear the auto-filled text and type your code exactly (e.g. `EARLY20`, `VIP50`, `10OFF`). Note: codes are case-insensitive at checkout, but punctuation matters — `10%OFF` and `10OFF` are different codes.
steps.label: Discount Code

steps.text: Optional: click **+ Add condition** to combine — e.g. Level equals Gold AND Discount Code equals VIP10 (code only works for Gold level).
steps.label: Add condition

steps.text: Under **THEN**, select **Apply Discount** (only action available for Discount Codes). Choose discount type: **Percentage** (e.g. 20% off), **Fixed Amount** (e.g. $50 off), or **Set Price** (force a specific price). Enter the amount.
steps.label: Apply Discount

steps.text: Set **APPLIES TO**: **Entire Cart** (all products), **Product Category** → Booth, or **Specific Product(s)** → click **Edit Selection** to choose specific packages, add-ons, or booths.
steps.label: APPLIES TO

steps.text: Optional **CODE DETAILS**: **Total Uses** (total times across all companies — blank = Unlimited), **Uses Per Company** (how many times one exhibitor can use it — blank = Unlimited), **Expiration Date** (code stops working after this date).
steps.label: Total Uses

steps.text: Optional **Notes**: internal admin notes — never shown to exhibitors.
steps.label: Notes

steps.text: Click **Save Rule** → ‘Rule created successfully’. The rule appears in **Your active rules** list.
steps.label: Save Rule

guides.notes:
Exhibitors enter the code in Review Cart -> Apply Discount. Turn a rule on/off with the toggle in 'Your active rules'. Edit (pencil), duplicate, or delete from 'Your active rules'. Hide the code box for all exhibitors via Event Setup > Advanced Settings > Hide Discount Code Field.

TROUBLESHOOTING - code not working:
(1) Spelling: must match exactly including punctuation (case-insensitive but 10%OFF != 10OFF).
(2) Expiry: check Expiration Date has not passed.
(3) Uses: check Total Uses or Uses Per Company are not exhausted.
(4) Applies To: confirm the code applies to the product type being purchased (package vs add-on vs booth).
(5) Rule enabled: check toggle is ON in Your active rules.
(6) Retroactive: discount codes do NOT apply to already-placed invoices.
(7) Combining rules: if multiple rules apply, rule priority order determines the result.

COMBINING CONDITIONS: Add IF Level equals <X> alongside the code to restrict it to certain levels (e.g. VIP members only).

FIXED AMOUNT vs SET PRICE: Fixed Amount subtracts (e.g. $50 off a $300 package = $250). Set Price forces a specific price regardless of original price (e.g. always $199).

steps.text: Open **Shop › Advanced** (tab **Payment Rules**).
steps.label: Payment Rules

steps.text: Click the **Early Bird Pricing** card to open ‘Create a Rule’ dialog.
steps.label: Early Bird Pricing

steps.text: Toggle **Rule is enabled** ON. Enter **Rule Name** (internal, e.g. ‘Early Bird 2025’) and **User-Facing Name** (shown in cart, e.g. ‘Early Registration Discount’).
steps.label: Rule is enabled

steps.text: In the **IF** section: condition shows ‘Date is before’. Click the date picker and select the deadline date (discount applies on orders placed ON or BEFORE this date). You can also choose ‘is after’ for late-registration fees.
steps.label: Date

steps.text: Optional: click **+ Add condition** to combine — e.g. Date is before [date] AND Level equals Gold (early bird only for Gold members), or add a Discount Code condition for an early-bird-plus-code combo.
steps.label: Add condition

steps.text: Under **THEN**, select the action: **Apply Discount** (most common), **Add Fee**, **Add Tax**, **Include Free Item**, or **Payment Options**. For early bird discount, choose **Apply Discount**.
steps.label: Apply Discount

steps.text: Choose discount type: **Percentage** (e.g. 20% off), **Fixed Amount** (e.g. $100 off), or **Set Price** (force a specific early-bird price, e.g. $500). Enter the amount.
steps.label: Apply Discount

steps.text: Set **APPLIES TO**: **Entire Cart** (all products), **Product Category** → Booth, or **Specific Product(s)** → click **Edit Selection** to pick specific packages, add-ons, or booths.
steps.label: APPLIES TO

steps.text: Optional **Notes**: internal notes (never shown to exhibitors).
steps.label: Notes

steps.text: Click **Save Rule** → ‘Rule created successfully’. Preview bar shows: ‘IF Date is before [date] → THEN apply X% off → TO [Entire Cart / product]’.
steps.label: Save Rule

guides.notes:
The early bird discount automatically STOPS applying after the deadline date - no manual action needed. The rule stays ON but the date condition no longer matches.

IF CONDITIONS AVAILABLE: Level / Discount Code / Payment Method / Date / Individual Product / Product Category / Quantity Purchased / Cart Amount - stack multiple conditions with AND logic.

THEN ACTIONS: Apply Discount (Percentage / Fixed Amount / Set Price) / Add Fee (charge extra after deadline) / Add Tax / Include Free Item / Payment Options.

FIXED AMOUNT vs SET PRICE: Fixed Amount subtracts from the product price (e.g. $100 off $500 = $400). Set Price forces a fixed price regardless of product's listed price (e.g. always $350 early bird).

APPLIES TO EXAMPLES:
- Entire Cart: 20% off everything in the cart
- Product Category > Booth: only booths get the discount, packages stay full price
- Specific Product(s) > Edit Selection > Packages > select 'Standard Package': only that package is discounted

DEBUGGING - early bird not applying:
(1) Date: confirm today's date is BEFORE the rule deadline. Check date is correct (year/month/day).
(2) Rule enabled: check toggle is ON in Your active rules.
(3) Applies To: make sure the discounted product type is in the cart.
(4) Rule priority: if another rule applies first, early bird may be overridden - reorder in Your active rules.
(5) Already placed invoices: early bird does NOT apply retroactively.
(6) Event dates: make sure event date fields are correct in Event Setup (some date rules reference them).

RULE PRIORITY: Rules apply in order shown in 'Your active rules'. Drag to reorder if two rules conflict. Higher priority rule wins when conditions overlap.

guides.title: Add a New Package or Add-On Product
questions: How do I add a new package?
How to create an add-on product?

steps.text: Go to **Shop › Products** in the left sidebar
steps.label: Products

steps.text: Click **Add New** under the Packages section (or Add-Ons section)
steps.label: Add New

steps.text: Fill in: Name, List Price, Stock Quantity, Assign Level (for Packages) or Level Visibility (for Add-Ons)
Optionally add an image, product description, and line item description
Under **Advanced**, set Group, Maximum Quantity Per Company, Tags
Under **Workflows**, set what happens when this product is purchased (assign tasks, priority points, level, booth staff limit)

guides.title: Create a New Task for Exhibitors

steps.text: Go to **Content › Tasks** in the left sidebar
steps.label: Tasks

steps.text: Click **Add New**
steps.label: Add New

steps.text: Set the Field Label (task name), Field Type (Text Box / Text Area / File Upload / URL / Dropdown / etc.)
Set the **Due Date** — this is required for the task to save
Set **Levels** to control which levels see this task (or leave as "All")
Optionally add Specifications (instructions for the exhibitor) and set Advanced Settings (lock when submitted, notifications)
Click **Save All Changes** at the top
steps.label: Save All Changes

guides.notes: Tasks can also be auto-assigned when a product is purchased via Workflows on the product. System tasks (Company Logo, Website, Contact Name, etc.) cannot be deleted.

guides.title: Task Not Showing for Exhibitor

steps.text: Go to **Content › Tasks** and find the task
steps.label: Tasks

steps.text: Check the **Levels** field — make sure the exhibitor's level is included (or it is set to "All")
Check **Select Exhibitors** field — if specific companies are set, make sure this company is listed
Verify the **Due Date** is set — tasks without a due date may not display
Click **Save All Changes** if you made any edits
steps.label: Save All Changes

guides.notes: Also confirm the exhibitor is looking at the correct portal and event. If tasks were assigned via product Workflows, check that the exhibitor has purchased that product.

guides.title: Package / Product Not Showing to Exhibitor

steps.text: Go to **Shop › Products** and find the package/add-on
steps.label: Products

steps.text: Check that **Item is visible** toggle is turned ON
Check **Stock Status** — if set to "No Longer Available" or Stock Quantity is 0, it will be hidden
For Packages: check **Assign Level** — if set to a specific level, the exhibitor must have that level
For Add-Ons: check **Level Visibility** — make sure the exhibitor's level is included
Also check **Event Setup › Registration Flow** — make sure the Shop/Select Package step is toggled ON
steps.label: Event Setup

guides.notes: 3-point checklist: (1) Product visible ON, (2) Stock available, (3) Level visibility matches exhibitor level.

steps.text: Step 1: Enter Event Name, Start/End Date, Venue Address, Portal URL (slug), Currency, Time Zone — click **Next**

guides.title: Build Your Own Pricing Rule

steps.text: Open **Shop › Advanced** (tab **Payment Rules**).
steps.label: Payment Rules

steps.text: Click the **Build Your Own Rule** card.
steps.label: Build Your Own Rule

steps.text: Enter a **Rule Name** (internal) and **User-Facing Name** (shown in cart).
steps.label: Rule Name

steps.text: Set the **IF** condition(s): Level, Discount Code, Payment Method, Date, Product, Product Category, Quantity, or Cart Amount. Click **+ Add condition** to stack multiple.

steps.text: Set the **THEN** action: Apply Discount (Percentage / Fixed Amount / Set Price), Add Fee, Add Tax, Include Free Item, or Payment Options.

guides.notes: Build Your Own Rule starts from a blank slate — same form as Level-Based Discounts, Early Bird, etc. but with no pre-set conditions. Every pre-built card is just this form with one condition pre-filled as a head start. Use it for any custom logic not covered by the pre-built cards.
